channel.title: Most Fascinating Stories
channel.description: History isn’t defined only by great treaties and epic battles—it turns on the bizarre, the terrifying, and the almost-forgotten coincidences that textbooks left behind. item.title: Episode 1: FDR and the Friendly Torpedo That Almost Killed Him
item.description: In November 1943, President Franklin D. Roosevelt embarked on a top-secret transatlantic voyage aboard the battleship USS Iowa to meet Churchill and Stalin in Tehran. During live combat exercises, an escort destroyer accidentally launched an armed torpedo directly at the President's ship. Hosted by Rebecca, with story narration by George.
